Features

Everything you need, at a glance

PAR is built to answer "what's going on right now?" instantly — no digging required.

⏱️

Live timers

Elapsed time and due-in countdowns update in real time, with overdue reports flashing so nothing slips by.

🔍

Instant search

Type to filter across any tab instantly. Your last search is remembered the next time you open PAR.

📌

One-click status filters

Click a status pill like "RTM" or "Due" to filter the table to just that group — click again to clear it.

🎓

Live / Training toggle

Show or hide training reports separately from live production work, so your view stays focused.

📍

Location filters

Narrow the view to Manila, Cebu, or Bogota — or see all three sites together.

🧩

Customizable columns

Show only the columns you care about. Your layout is saved automatically for next time.

🚩

Duplicate work alerts

If the same tech shows up on more than one in-progress report, PAR flags it so it can be caught early.

📋

Queue counts

Check live queue counts for drops, RTM, RFQC, and Hipster queues — and copy them to your clipboard in one click.

⬇️

Export to CSV

Export exactly what you see — your visible columns, your filtered rows — to a spreadsheet in one click.

🔄

Always fresh

The dashboard auto-reloads every few minutes to keep data current, and pauses automatically while you're viewing a report.

🌗

Light & dark mode

Switch themes with one click. PAR remembers your preference for next time.

🕒

Three-site clock

See the current time in Manila, the US, and Bogota at a glance, with day/night icons.

Double-click any report for the full story

No need to leave PAR to get context on a report — everything you need opens right there in a detail view.

  • Report images, viewable full-size
  • Address, product type, and key report info
  • Measurement counts and QC notes
  • Full history of the report's status changes
  • Rework details when a report's been sent back
  • One-click shortcuts to open the file location or map

First Time Only

How to run PAR

You only need to do this once — after that, PAR lives on your desktop.

1
Copy and paste this into your File Explorer address bar:
📁 P:\1_Coordinators\PIA\PAR.lnk
💡 This is one time only. Running it will create a PAR shortcut on your Desktop — from then on, just double-click that shortcut to launch PAR.
Look for this on your Desktop This is the PAR shortcut icon — double-click it any time to launch the app.
Getting Started

Up and running in seconds

No setup, no accounts to create — just open it and go.

1

Open PAR from your desktop

Double-click the PAR shortcut — it's kept up to date automatically.

2

Pick your tab

Choose Measure or QC depending on what you're working on.

3

Search, filter, and dig in

Use search, filters, and columns to find what matters, then double-click any report for full details.
